# Dropout intentions among undergraduate students: factors and solutions (ongoing research)

- [Start](https://www.eafit.edu.co/)
- Eafit Quality
- [Statistical Bulletin](https://www.eafit.edu.co/calidad-eafit/boletin-estadistico)
- [Saber Pro 2018 Results](https://www.eafit.edu.co/calidad-eafit/boletin-estadistico/resultados-saber-pro-2018)
- Dropout Intentions Among Undergraduate Students: Factors and Solutions (Ongoing Research)

In Colombia, a post-hoc approach has prevailed in the study of student dropout, which analyzes students who have already abandoned their studies. From this perspective, a considerable number of studies have been developed with the purpose of identifying causes, variables, and determining risks in the interruption of the academic process of Colombian students.

However, after nearly a decade of studies and policies, student dropout remains a pressing issue in the country. The national university dropout rate per cohort has remained almost constant since 2007 (42%). Against this backdrop, EAFIT University addressed the problem of dropout in higher education through a study with a different, a priori, approach: analyzing students who have not yet decided to withdraw from their undergraduate studies but have expressed the intention to do so.

The main purpose of the study was to measure the effect of student satisfaction and learning outcomes on their intention to drop out, in order to develop strategies aimed at current and prospective students to strengthen their experience at EAFIT University. The study employed a quantitative methodology (psychometrics). The second phase of the study is currently underway, with the aim of expanding upon and deepening the variables and relationships that influence dropout intentions identified in the first phase, and identifying strategies to promote student retention.

[See the full report with the results for each undergraduate program.](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/s/wcc2lrqx5g/2014-documentos-trabajo)
